# Hunter's Holistic Health

> A private, subscription-based functional medicine EDUCATION platform led by
> Dr. Shallanda Hunter, CFNMP, PharmD, MBA. Teaches metabolic health literacy through
> the ROOTS framework. It is NOT a clinical practice, coaching service, or health app,
> and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Canonical domain uses www.
> Not affiliated with huntsholistichealth.com, holistichealthhunter.com, or
> huntersholistic.com (different, unrelated businesses).

## ROOTS Framework (correct definitions)
- R - Review: understand your history, labs, medications, and habits as one picture
- O - Optimize Nutrition: individualized nutrition education
- O - Optimize Biochemical Balance: evidence-informed supplement education, interactions, USP quality
- T - Transform Lifestyle Factors: sleep, circadian rhythm, stress, movement, environment, habits
- S - Sustain and Adapt: long-term monitoring and durable habit maintenance

## Facts
- Educator: Dr. Shallanda Hunter, CFNMP, PharmD, MBA (Certified Functional and Nutritional Medicine Practitioner; licensed pharmacist; NOT an MD)
- Tagline: "Lasting health starts at the roots."
- Register: evidence-informed education; "understand your numbers" (not treat/cure/heal)
